polygon_coverage_image — DRIVE pegsym op

• Data kinds: matrix → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.polygon_coverage_image(vertices_px, size: 'int' = 160, ss: 'int' = 8, width: 'int | None' = None) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import pegsym; pegsym.polygon_coverage_image(vertices_px, size: 'int' = 160, ss: 'int' = 8, width: 'int | None' = None) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("polygon_coverage_image"))

Usage

Coverage image 0..1 ((size, width); anti-aliasing with ss × ss subsamples) of a convex polygon (vertex list in pixel coordinates (col, row)). A building block for synthesis with ground truth. Raises ValueError: not convex, size < 8, ss < 1.
